name: Tm Flexible Selections
pitch: Bring clear filters for many fields together, with a display that fits each one.
question: Which selections help me focus on the part of the business I need?
questions: How can I narrow a sheet by region, year and date range?
Which values are selected, possible or excluded?
How can I change an app variable or return to a saved selection?
useWhen: Bring several related filters together on a sheet
audience: Qlik analysts and app builders who need several filters in one place.
features: Several field filters in one object
Tiles, lists, dropdowns and single-value controls
Date ranges and editable app variables
App bookmarks and fields that share a filter slot
Nine starting looks with colours, fonts and spacing
Selected and locked values marked beyond colour

featureStrips.heading: Give filters a look that fits the sheet
featureStrips.text: Nine starting looks offer tiles, pills, check boxes and more, with colours, fonts, borders and spacing you can change.
featureStrips.alt: Demo App showing nine filter looks for the same region and category values.

featureStrips.heading: Keep single-value controls together
featureStrips.text: A radio list, a two-value switch and editable app variable controls sit beside the chart they help users explore.
featureStrips.alt: Demo App with category radio buttons, a large-order switch, a variable select and a slider beside a bar chart.

featureStrips.heading: Carry the meaning of colour into filters
featureStrips.text: Expression colours or master dimension colours let field values use a colour scheme that fits the rest of the app.
featureStrips.alt: Demo App with blue region tiles and region tiles in four different colours above a quantity chart.

featureStrips.heading: Focus a sheet on a date range
featureStrips.text: From and To inputs and quick ranges let users narrow date selections without picking individual dates from a list.
featureStrips.alt: Demo App with From and To date inputs and quick ranges beside customer and category tables.
